title: Gulf‑Front 30A Home – Rooftop Deck & Beachfront Views
meta_description: High Tide — stunning 4BR/3BA Gulf‑front 30A home with rooftop deck, panoramic beach views, multiple balconies, stocked kitchen, paddle boards, beach gear, and direct access to Santa Rosa Beach. Sleeps 8—book your beachfront escape.
description_expanded: AboutHigh Tide | Gulf Front 30A Vacation Rental in Santa Rosa Beach with Rooftop Deck and Stunning Views What Guests Love About High Tide: • True Gulf front 30A vacation rental with unobstructed beach and Gulf views • Open concept living area overlooking the Gulf and sugar-white sand • Expansive front and back balconies on multiple levels • Rooftop deck with panoramic Gulf views • Second lounging area with TV and kitchenette for flexible gathering space • Fully stocked kitchen with standalone ice maker and spices • Outdoor grill for easy beachside cookouts • Full-size washer and dryer for added convenience during longer stays • Four bedrooms and three bathrooms designed for comfort and flexibility • Gulf front Santa Rosa Beach location directly on Scenic Highway 30A • Plenty of parking for multiple vehicles • Games, cards, books, and puzzles for family-friendly entertainment • Pack and Play for traveling families • Backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella provided • Two paddle boards included for exploring the Gulf • Close to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, dining, boutique shopping, and entertainment A Gulf Front 30A Vacation Rental with Unforgettable Views Welcome to High Tide, a stunning Gulf front vacation rental located along Scenic Highway 30A in Santa Rosa Beach. Designed for guests seeking breathtaking views, direct beach access, and upscale coastal comfort, this four-bedroom, three-bathroom home offers an elevated Emerald Coast experience with panoramic views of the Gulf from every level. From the moment you arrive, High Tide delivers the ultimate beachfront lifestyle — where mornings begin with sunrise over the water and evenings end with incredible sunsets and the sound of waves just steps away. Open Concept Living with Gulf Views The main living level features a bright, open concept layout designed to showcase the spectacular Gulf front setting. Walls of windows frame endless views of the beach and emerald waters, filling the space with natural light. The living area flows seamlessly into the dining space and fully stocked kitchen, making it easy for everyone to gather while still enjoying the view. Whether you are relaxing after a beach day or sharing meals with family and friends, this space is designed for connection and comfort. The kitchen includes: • Stainless steel appliances • Standalone ice maker • Spices and cooking essentials • Ample counter space for meal prep and entertaining Multiple Living Spaces for Relaxation High Tide offers a second lounging area complete with a TV and kitchenette, providing a perfect retreat for movie nights, kids’ hangouts, or quieter moments away from the main living space. This flexible layout is ideal for families, multi-generational groups, or guests who appreciate having room to spread out. Spacious Bedrooms with Coastal Comfort This Santa Rosa Beach vacation rental features four thoughtfully designed bedrooms and three bathrooms, offering comfortable accommodations for families and groups. Each bedroom provides a relaxing retreat after long days at the beach, while the home’s multiple living spaces ensure everyone has room to unwind. Outdoor Living at Its Best Outdoor living is where High Tide truly shines. Expansive balconies on both the front and back of the home provide multiple places to enjoy Gulf breezes, morning coffee, or sunset cocktails. The rooftop deck offers sweeping panoramic views of the Gulf and coastline, creating a one-of-a-kind setting for unforgettable moments. Additional outdoor features include: • Outdoor grill for beachside dining • Plenty of parking for convenience • Backpack beach chairs and umbrella • Two paddle boards for Gulf adventures Family-Friendly Extras High Tide is designed with families in mind and includes: • Games, cards, books, and puzzles • Pack and Play • Full-size washer and dryer for easy laundry during extended stays Prime 30A Location Near Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach Located in Santa Rosa Beach along Scenic Highway 30A, High Tide places you close to some of the most iconic destinations on the Emerald Coast. Enjoy quick access to Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, along with incredible dining, boutique shopping, coffee shops, and local entertainment. Whether you spend your days paddle boarding, strolling the shoreline, exploring nearby coastal towns, or relaxing on the balcony with a view, High Tide offers the perfect balance of convenience and serenity. Your Gulf Front Escape Awaits With its unbeatable Gulf front location, breathtaking views, rooftop deck, and thoughtful amenities, High Tide is a standout luxury 30A vacation rental designed for unforgettable coastal living. Book your stay at High Tide and experience the very best of Santa Rosa Beach and Scenic Highway 30A from a true Gulf front retreat.
